description: The half-Betazoid empath Deanna Troi has seen, experienced and, more specifically, felt much over almost two decades serving under Captain Jean-Luc Picard on the U.S.S. Enterprise. She is a trusted confidant and advisor whose wisdom is often sought. While Deanna’s empathy gives her an insight into the hearts and minds, her keen intelligence gives her the ability to interpret those insights into tactical, strategic options that have proved their worth again and again in service to the crew of the Enterprise. That ability has only been honed and refined over the years, to the point where Deanna has become an integral member of the command team. But if Deanna is indispensable to her shipmates, then she is absolutely essential to her husband, partner, and the love of her life, William T. Riker. Just like the crew relies on the helm to get them where they’re going, in matters of the heart, he relies on Troi to steer his course true. In turbulent waters or calm, Deanna Troi is the anchor you can trust to keep you stable.
